lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters positioned across the mid-flank. These maxima are arranged in approximately equidistant horizontal and vertical rows, with the highest contrast clusters located in the central and posterior sections of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a lattice-like visual structure where the blobs act as nodes within faint vertical columns.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature running parallel to the dorsal-lateral axis, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high (top) to low (bottom) forming a distinct ridge shadow.
